fields.name: QOS_FIXED_VALUE
fields.description: Fixed mode 輸出 qos 值 (0~15)

registers.name: BASE_QOS
registers.description: Regulator 基礎 qos + URGENCY_STEP combined. See §BASE_QOS for field layout. <!-- source: 06_qos.md §4.1 + §4.5 (post-fix) -->

fields.name: BASE_QOS
fields.description: Regulator mode 基礎 QoS 值 (urgency_level=0 時使用，0~15). See ToO §QoSGen.

fields.name: URGENCY_STEP
fields.description: Urgency 每次調整的步進值 (1~3；軟體寫 0 時硬體視同 1). See ToO §QoSGen Regulator mode.

registers.name: TXN_MIN_LATENCY
registers.description: 最小延遲 (16-bit; initialised to all-1s sentinel value; first observed transaction-latency overwrites; subsequent observations write only if smaller). Cleared back to 0xFFFF via `TXN_PROBE_EN` 1→0→1 transition.

registers.name: ERR_STATUS
registers.description: 錯誤狀態 — write 1 to clear bit and the associated saturating counter. See §ERR_STATUS. <!-- source: 06_qos.md §4.1, post-fix RW1C -->

fields.name: ecc_uncorr_err
fields.description: flit_ecc 雙位元錯偵測到 (corrupted flit forwarded; AXI rresp 不變). Write 1 clears bit + `ECC_UNCORR_ERR_CNT`.

fields.name: route_par_err
fields.description: route_par mismatch detected by router or NI sink (offending flit dropped). Write 1 clears bit + `ROUTE_PAR_ERR_CNT`.

fields.name: axi_parity_err
fields.description: AXI host-side parity mismatch (NMU-side AW/AR/W input parity OR NSU-side rdata parity). Transaction is logged but not aborted. Write 1 clears bit + `AXI_PARITY_ERR_CNT`.

registers.name: ECC_UNCORR_ERR_CNT
registers.description: ECC uncorrectable 錯誤計數 (saturating, `ERR_COUNTER_WIDTH` bits). Cleared via `ERR_STATUS[0]` write-1 (ecc_uncorr_err).

registers.name: LAST_ERR_INFO
registers.description: 最近錯誤資訊 (sticky semantics; see §LAST_ERR_INFO for field layout).

fields.name: err_axi_id
fields.description: 錯誤 transaction 的 AXI ID.

registers.name: (reserved for `LAST_ERR_INFO_HI`)
registers.description: Allocated for compile-time `LAST_ERR_INFO` extension when total field width exceeds 32 bits (e.g., `AXI_ID_WIDTH=16` with extended `X_WIDTH+Y_WIDTH`). Unused at default parameters; reads as DECERR until activated.

registers.name: IRQ_ENABLE
registers.description: Per-bit IRQ mask, layout 1:1 with `ERR_STATUS`. `irq_o = OR over i of (ERR_STATUS[i] & IRQ_ENABLE[i])`. Default 0 = all IRQs masked; software opts in. See §IRQ_ENABLE for field layout.

registers.name: ECC_CORR_ERR_CNT
registers.description: flit_ecc 單位元（已修正）錯誤累計 (saturating, `ERR_COUNTER_WIDTH` bits). Pure informational; cumulative since hardware reset; no software clear path. Software polls and tracks deltas for health-monitoring purposes.

registers.name: ROUTE_PAR_ERR_CNT
registers.description: route_par mismatch (flit dropped at router/sink) 累計 (saturating, `ERR_COUNTER_WIDTH` bits). Cleared via `ERR_STATUS[1]` write-1 (route_par_err).

registers.name: AXI_PARITY_ERR_CNT
registers.description: AXI host-side parity mismatch 累計 (saturating, `ERR_COUNTER_WIDTH` bits). Covers both NMU-side `axi_*_i_par_i` checks and NSU-side `axi_rdata_par_i` checks. Cleared via `ERR_STATUS[2]` write-1 (axi_parity_err).

registers.name: PENDING_R_COUNT
registers.description: NMU live outstanding read transactions. Width = `ceil(log2(MAX_TXNS+1))`. AXI-edge-defined per `protocol_rules.md` `NI_CFG_PENDING_COUNT_ACCURACY`. See §PENDING_R_COUNT.

registers.name: PENDING_W_COUNT
registers.description: NMU live outstanding write transactions. Same width formula and contract as `PENDING_R_COUNT`. See §PENDING_W_COUNT.

fields.name: quiesce_req
fields.description: Software requests NMU quiesce. `1`: NMU stops accepting new AW/AR (holds `axi_awready_o = axi_arready_o = 0`); existing in-flight transactions drain via normal response paths. `0`: resume normal NMU operation. NSU continues servicing inbound NoC requests in either state — quiesce is NMU-only by design.

fields.name: quiesce_idle
fields.description: Asserts when `(QUIESCE_CTRL.quiesce_req=1) AND (PENDING_R_COUNT=0) AND (PENDING_W_COUNT=0)`. Combinational over `aclk_i`-domain values (no CDC). Software polls this bit after writing `quiesce_req=1` to know when reconfig is safe. Polling is best-effort — no NI-side liveness guarantee in v0.4.0. If a slave hangs, `quiesce_idle` never asserts and software handles upper-bounded retry / reset externally. Deasserts on the cycle `quiesce_req` is cleared (because the AND-condition's first term goes false).

registers.name: EXCLUSIVE_MONITOR_CTRL
registers.description: NSU Exclusive Monitor `clear_all` trigger (W1 self-clearing). See §EXCLUSIVE_MONITOR_CTRL.

fields.name: clear_all
fields.description: Write-1 self-clearing trigger: invalidates all pending NSU Exclusive Monitor entries on the `aclk_i` edge that completes the CSR write handshake (the "clear epoch" boundary). The bit self-clears on the next `aclk_i` edge after the clear epoch (latency = 1 cycle); subsequent reads return 0. Use case: OS bookkeeping when a process is killed mid-Exclusive. Race semantics with concurrent NSU events formalised in `protocol_rules.md` `NI_CFG_EXCLUSIVE_CLEAR_RACE`.

registers.name: EXCLUSIVE_MONITOR_STATUS
registers.description: NSU Exclusive Monitor live `occupancy` count. See §EXCLUSIVE_MONITOR_STATUS.
